name: Der Schwur des KÄRNAN
description: Der Schwur des KÄRNAN (The Oath of Kärnan) is Hansa-Park's flagship coaster, opened on 1 July 2015. The track climbs to 73 m, the top speed is 127 km/h and riders go through one inversion, all beside the park's 79 m Kärnan tower. Min 130cm.

name: Flucht von Novgorod
description: Flucht von Novgorod (Escape of Novgorod) is a steel coaster that opened on 9 April 2009. It reaches 100 km/h and sends riders through an inversion, on a track roughly 35 to 40 m high depending on the source. Min 125cm.

name: Cornwall Coaster
description: Cornwall Coaster is Hansa-Park's newest ride, a family coaster that opened on 23 May 2026. It is 18 m high with a top speed of 50 km/h, a good step up for children ready for their first real coaster. Min 90cm.

name: HIGHLANDER
description: HIGHLANDER is a gyro drop tower that opened in April 2019. Riders are lifted to 120 m, the ride rotates as it drops 103 m and speeds reach about 120 km/h, with wide views over the Baltic coast from the top. Min 140cm.

name: NESSIE
description: NESSIE is a classic Hansa-Park coaster that opened in 1980. It stands 26 m high, reaches 79 km/h and includes one inversion. A long-time favourite for riders ready for their first looping. Min 100cm.

name: Die Schlange von Midgard
description: Die Schlange von Midgard (The Midgard Serpent) is a Viking-themed junior coaster that opened in 2011. It is 10 m high with a top speed of 45 km/h, a gentle ride for younger children. Min 100cm.

name: Royal Scotsman
description: Royal Scotsman is a family coaster that opened in 1993 under the name Rasender Roland. It is 16 m high with a top speed of 50 km/h and no inversions. Min 100cm.

name: Crazy Mine
description: Crazy Mine is a wild mouse coaster that opened in 1997. Small cars twist through sharp, flat bends on a 15 m high track at up to 45 km/h. Min 110cm.

name: KÄRNAPULTEN
description: KÄRNAPULTEN is a Sky Fly thrill ride that opened on 14 April 2017. It lifts riders 22 m into the air for a flying, swinging ride high above the park. Min 125cm.

name: Störtebekers Kaperfahrt
description: Störtebekers Kaperfahrt (Störtebeker's Sea Raid) is a spinning raft ride that opened in 2000 as Rio Dorado. Rafts twist down a 20 m high course and riders can get wet, so it is a favourite on warm days. Minimum age 4.

name: Wildwasserfahrt – Der Wasserwolf am Ilmensee
description: Wildwasserfahrt – Der Wasserwolf am Ilmensee is Hansa-Park's classic log flume, a 15 m high splash ride from the 1970s with a big plunge at the end. Perfect for cooling off on a hot day.

name: Super Splash
description: Super Splash is a log flume that opened in 1986. Boats climb to 20 m before a big splashing plunge that soaks everyone on board.

name: Barracuda Slide
description: Barracuda Slide is a set of water slides that opened in 1998, reaching 12 m in height, a fun way to cool off on a summer day.

name: Fliegender Holländer
description: Fliegender Holländer (Flying Dutchman) is a pirate-ship swing ride that has been part of Hansa-Park since 1981. The big ship swings back and forth, giving a classic weightless thrill.

name: Wellenreiter
description: Wellenreiter (Wave Rider) is a Troika thrill ride that has been part of the park since 1977, a classic fairground-style ride for guests who like to be thrown around.
